travelPace.description: While traveling, a group of adventurers can move at a Normal, Fast, or Slow pace.
travelPace.forcedMarch: For each additional hour of travel beyond 8 hours, characters must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw at the end of every hour. The DC increases by 1 for each hour past 8. On a failed save, a character gains 1 level of Exhaustion.

mounts.description: A mount can allow you to travel faster, but it must rest periodically.
mounts.galloping: For short bursts of speed (up to 1 hour), you can move at twice the normal pace. This uses the mount's Dash action.
mounts.rest: Mounts require rest after galloping and can't maintain a fast pace for the full day without risking Exhaustion.

vehicles.description: Characters in wagons, carriages, or other land vehicles can travel at the normal pace.
vehicles.waterborne: Waterborne vessels travel 24 hours per day if the crew works in shifts. For each 24-hour period of travel, add the vessel's speed (in miles per hour) × 24.
